requirements: Instinct detects patterns from a corpus with status=PASS-only receipts
Three new detectors: module activation frequency, phase distribution, complexity skew
New patterns use same output format as existing patterns (type, name, confidence, evidence, description)
success_criteria: instinct.py --activate on 143-receipt corpus produces at least 1 pattern
failure_modes: New detectors produce false positives requiring threshold tuning
Pattern count too high making output noisy
